grammar.summary: 本课学习 How do you do? 正式问候与介绍他人的句型。

points.title: How do you do? 初次见面正式问候
points.explanation: 非常正式的初次见面问候，回答也是 How do you do?（不说 fine）。比 Nice to meet you 更正式，多用于商务场合。

examples.en: How do you do? How do you do?

points.title: 介绍句型 This is...
points.explanation: 向第三方介绍某人用 This is + 人名，不能说 He is...（那是我介绍的对象，不是他）。

exercises.q: Those men are lazy. ___ are sales reps.
That man is tall. ___ is a policeman.
Look at Nicola. ___ is very pretty.
Michael Baker and Jeremy Short are employees.___ are sales reps.
